comment: Names every content source the renderer reads so a publisher outside this repository can learn the shape without executing it. It grants nothing; authority lives in writable-paths.v1.json and approval-policy.v1.json.

site.comment: The strict public-facts record: consulate phone and email (the two governed coupled sets), street address, jurisdiction note, Wellington embassy referral and footer identity. Every occurrence of a governed fact on the rendered site derives from this file.

sections.comment: Per-page section records with a markdown body, Zod-validated by Astro's content layer. Not writable by any declared operation.

insights.comment: Authored publications with a PDF and hero image per record. Media-bearing; not writable.

pages.comment: Only home.md today, marked draft: true.

hosting.comment: Publication requires a Vercel project connected to this repository (vercel.json); the publisher proves preview rendering and production settlement only against the Vercel Deployments API. The former Cloudflare Pages CLI deploy (npm run deploy:cloudflare) is retained for manual use but is not a governed publication path.
